name: @zhadyz/mnemosyne-mcp-router

tools.name: create_entities
tools.description: Create multiple new entities in your Memento MCP knowledge graph memory system

observations.description: An array of observation contents associated with the entity

tools.name: create_relations
tools.description: Create multiple new relations between entities in your Memento MCP knowledge graph memory. Relations should be in active voice

from.description: The name of the entity where the relation starts

to.description: The name of the entity where the relation ends

confidence.description: Optional confidence level in relation accuracy (0.0 to 1.0)

metadata.description: Optional metadata about the relation (source, timestamps, tags, etc.)

tools.name: add_observations
tools.description: Add new observations to existing entities in your Memento MCP knowledge graph memory

entityName.description: The name of the entity to add the observations to

contents.description: An array of observation contents to add

strength.description: Strength value (0.0 to 1.0) for this specific observation

confidence.description: Confidence level (0.0 to 1.0) for this specific observation

strength.description: Default strength value (0.0 to 1.0) for all observations

confidence.description: Default confidence level (0.0 to 1.0) for all observations

tools.name: delete_entities
tools.description: Delete multiple entities and their associated relations from your Memento MCP knowledge graph memory

entityNames.description: An array of entity names to delete

tools.name: delete_observations
tools.description: Delete specific observations from entities in your Memento MCP knowledge graph memory

entityName.description: The name of the entity containing the observations

observations.description: An array of observations to delete

tools.name: delete_relations
tools.description: Delete multiple relations from your Memento MCP knowledge graph memory

from.description: The name of the entity where the relation starts

to.description: The name of the entity where the relation ends

relations.description: An array of relations to delete

tools.name: get_relation
tools.description: Get a specific relation with its enhanced properties from your Memento MCP knowledge graph memory

from.description: The name of the entity where the relation starts

to.description: The name of the entity where the relation ends

tools.name: update_relation
tools.description: Update an existing relation with enhanced properties in your Memento MCP knowledge graph memory

from.description: The name of the entity where the relation starts

to.description: The name of the entity where the relation ends

confidence.description: Optional confidence level in relation accuracy (0.0 to 1.0)

metadata.description: Optional metadata about the relation (source, timestamps, tags, etc.)

tools.name: read_graph
tools.description: Read the entire Memento MCP knowledge graph memory system

tools.name: search_nodes
tools.description: Search for nodes in your Memento MCP knowledge graph memory based on a query

query.description: The search query to match against entity names, types, and observation content

tools.name: open_nodes
tools.description: Open specific nodes in your Memento MCP knowledge graph memory by their names

names.description: An array of entity names to retrieve

tools.name: semantic_search
tools.description: Search for entities semantically using vector embeddings and similarity in your Memento MCP knowledge graph memory

query.description: The text query to search for semantically

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10)

hybrid_search.description: Whether to combine keyword and semantic search (default: true)

semantic_weight.description: Weight of semantic results in hybrid search from 0.0 to 1.0 (default: 0.6)

tools.name: get_entity_embedding
tools.description: Get the vector embedding for a specific entity from your Memento MCP knowledge graph memory

entity_name.description: The name of the entity to get the embedding for

tools.name: get_entity_history
tools.description: Get the version history of an entity from your Memento MCP knowledge graph memory

entityName.description: The name of the entity to retrieve history for

tools.name: get_relation_history
tools.description: Get the version history of a relation from your Memento MCP knowledge graph memory

from.description: The name of the entity where the relation starts

to.description: The name of the entity where the relation ends

tools.name: get_graph_at_time
tools.description: Get your Memento MCP knowledge graph memory as it existed at a specific point in time

timestamp.description: The timestamp (in milliseconds since epoch) to query the graph at

tools.name: get_decayed_graph
tools.description: Get your Memento MCP knowledge graph memory with confidence values decayed based on time

reference_time.description: Optional reference timestamp (in milliseconds since epoch) for decay calculation

decay_factor.description: Optional decay factor override (normally calculated from half-life)
